Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Recruit

A permanent teleportation circle, made by the Teleportation Circle spell, is inscribed on the floor of this room.

Recruit: Spellcaster. The hireling invites a Friendly NPC spellcaster. Roll any die: on an odd number, the invitation is declined and you gain nothing; on an even number, the spellcaster accepts and arrives through your circle. While you are in your Bastion, you can ask them to cast one Wizard spell of level 4 or lower (level 8 or lower if you are level 17+); they are assumed to have it prepared, and you pay for any costly Material components. The spellcaster stays for 14 days or until they cast a spell for you; they won't defend your Bastion and leave at once if it is attacked.
